issues.title: [P0] #562 [OPENCODE] [DRAFT] Priority Fees v2 — simulateAndSend, Helius + Jito failover, health monitor
issues.body:
## Objective
Implement Priority Fees v2 module (`goalchain_oracle/src/priority-fees/`) per GitHub issue #486 / #377. This is critical infrastructure for all oracle transactions — replaces ad-hoc `sendWithPriorityFees` with production-grade module.

## Scope & Files to Create
**New module:** `goalchain_oracle/src/priority-fees/`

1. **`priority-fees/src/types.ts`** — Canonical fee tiers + interfaces
   - `FeeTier` enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL with CU and fee multipliers
   - `PriorityFeeConfig` interface: heliusRpcUrl, jitoBlockEngineUrl, feeTiers, healthCheckIntervalMs
   - `SimulateResult` interface: success, computeUnitsConsumed, logs, error

2. **`priority-fees/src/helius-client.ts`** — Helius RPC + priority fee estimation
   - `HeliusPriorityFeeClient` class with `getPriorityFeeEstimate(tier)` and `getRecentPriorityFees()`

3. **`priority-fees/src/jito-failover.ts`** — Jito Block Engine failover
   - `JitoFailoverClient` class with `submitBundle(transactions)` and `getBundleStatus(bundleId)`

4. **`priority-fees/src/simulate-and-send.ts`** — Core: simulate → validate → send
   - `simulateAndSend(connection, wallet, instructions, tier = MEDIUM, useJito = false)`
   - Steps: build v0 tx with compute budget → simulate via Helius RPC → validate success + CU within tier → if useJito && tier >= HIGH: submit to Jito → else send via connection.sendTransaction with priority fee → confirm with commitment

5. **`priority-fees/src/health-monitor.ts`** — RPC health + circuit breaker
   - `RpcHealthMonitor` class with `checkHealth()`, `recordFailure(rpcUrl)`, `getBestRpc()`
   - Tracks RPC latency + failure rate, circuit breaker switches RPC on sustained failures

6. **`priority-fees/index.ts`** — Barrel export + factory
   - Export all types, classes, and `createPriorityFeeModule(config)`

7. **`priority-fees/tests/simulate-and-send.test.ts`** — Unit tests with mocked RPC

## Config Required in `config.env`
```
HELIUS_RPC_URL=https://devnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=xxx
JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL=https://testnet.block-engine.jito.wtf
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_LOW_CU=2000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_LOW_FEE=5000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_MEDIUM_CU=100000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_MEDIUM_FEE=50000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_HIGH_CU=500000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_HIGH_FEE=200000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_CRITICAL_CU=1000000
PRIORITY_FEE_TIER_CRITICAL_FEE=1000000
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- `simulateAndSend` returns simulation result before sending
- Helius priority fee estimation works
- Jito failover submits bundles on HIGH/CRITICAL tiers
- Health monitor tracks RPC latency + failure rate
- Circuit breaker switches RPC on sustained failures
- Unit tests pass with mocked RPC
- Integration test on devnet (optional)

## Test Commands
```bash
cd goalchain_oracle && npm test -- priority-fees
npm run test:integration:priority-fees  # devnet
```

## Risks & Rollback
- Helius API changes: version pin in package.json
- Jito testnet unavailable: fallback to non-Jito send with warning
- If simulation passes but send fails: retry with next RPC, log for analysis

## Required First Output: Plan JSON
Before any code changes, output this JSON to stdout:

issues.title: [P1] #470 [OPENCODE] [opencode] P1: Fix the failing vault crank by converting sequential transactions into an atomic Jito bundle submitted to the testnet Block Engine. This unblocks the buyback/burn loop and activates MEV-enhanced yield recycling.
issues.body:
## Objective
Fix the failing vault crank by converting sequential transactions into an atomic Jito bundle submitted to the testnet Block Engine. This unblocks the buyback/burn loop and activates MEV-enhanced yield recycling.

## Context
- **Current state:** `/api/ops/status` shows vault crank last ran 2026-05-27, simulation failing with "instruction changed the balance of a read-only account"
- **Root cause:** Legacy `sendWithPriorityFees` without simulation/failover; sequential txs can partially fail
- **Jito integration exists:** GoalChain already has Stake Pool CPI (`SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy`) and `treasury_jito_ata` on-chain

## Solution: Jito Bundle Atomic Execution
Bundle 3 transactions atomically (all succeed or all fail):
1. **Jupiter Swap** — SOL → GCH (via Jupiter v6 on devnet)
2. **Burn GCH** — Transfer GCH to burn authority / invoke burn instruction
3. **Jito Tip** — Transfer SOL to one of 8 Jito tip accounts (min 1,000 lamports)

## Implementation Details
**File to modify:** `goalchain_oracle/src/vault_crank.ts`

**New dependencies:** 
- `@jito-foundation/block-engine-sdk` or raw JSON-RPC to `https://testnet.block-engine.jito.wtf`
- Jupiter devnet SDK for swap quote + transaction building

**Bundle submission flow:**
```typescript
const BLOCK_ENGINE_URL = process.env.JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL || 'https://testnet.block-engine.jito.wtf';
const TIP_ACCOUNTS = [/* 8 hardcoded tip accounts */];

async function executeVaultCrankBundle(connection, wallet, excessSol) {
  // 1. Get Jupiter swap quote (SOL → GCH)
  const quote = await jupiter.getQuote({ inputMint: SOL_MINT, outputMint: GCH_MINT, amount: excessSol });
  const swapTx = await jupiter.getSwapTransaction({ quote, userPublicKey: wallet.publicKey });
  
  // 2. Build burn instruction (GCH → burn)
  const burnIx = createBurnInstruction({ mint: GCH_MINT, amount: quote.outAmount, authority: wallet.publicKey });
  const burnTx = new Transaction().add(burnIx);
  
  // 3. Tip instruction (random tip account)
  const tipAccount = TIP_ACCOUNTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * TIP_ACCOUNTS.length)];
  const tipIx = SystemProgram.transfer({ fromPubkey: wallet.publicKey, toPubkey: tipAccount, lamports: 5000 });
  const tipTx = new Transaction().add(tipIx);
  
  // 4. Submit bundle
  const bundleId = await sendBundle(BLOCK_ENGINE_URL, [swapTx, burnTx, tipTx]);
  return await waitForBundleConfirmation(connection, bundleId);
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Vault crank runs successfully on devnet via `GET /api/ops/status` → `vault_crank.stale: false`
- [ ] Buyback SOL → GCH swap executes via Jupiter on devnet
- [ ] GCH burn transaction confirms on-chain
- [ ] Jito tip paid (verify via `getBundleStatuses` + tip account balance)
- [ ] Economy health improves: `vault_buyback_coverage` > 0.25, `emit_burn_ratio_7d` moves toward 0.85
- [ ] Simulation passes before real send (integrate with Issue #377 `simulateAndSend`)

## Dependencies
- **Blocker:** Issue #377 (Priority Fees v2) — needs `simulateAndSend` for preflight validation
- **Config:** Add `JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL=https://testnet.block-engine.jito.wtf` to `config.env`
- **Env:** Ensure `GCH_MINT`, `SOL_MINT`, Jupiter devnet endpoint available

## Testing
```bash
# Manual test
curl -X POST https://testnet.block-engine.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"sendBundle","params":[["<base64_tx1>","<base64_tx2>","<base64_tx3>"],{"encoding":"base64"}]}'

# Verify on-chain
curl -s https://crm.goalchain.fun/goalchain-api/api/ops/status | jq '.vault_crank'
curl -s https://crm.goalchain.fun/goalchain-api/api/economy/health | jq '.checks[] | select(.key=="vault_buyback_coverage")'
```

## Priority
**P0** — Highest leverage Jito opportunity; unblocks core economic loop

`agent:opencode`, `priority:P0`, `area:oracle`, `jito`, `mev`, `devnet`

# [OPENCODE] [P0] #361 Design System — Tokens + Styles Structure (HSL, glassmorphism, motion)

## Priority: P0 (webapp foundation)
## Labels: agent:opencode, priority:P0, area:webapp, status:ready

## Objective
Create canonical design system tokens and base styles for GoalChain webapp.

## Deliverables
```
goalchain_webapp/src/styles/
├── tokens/
│   ├── colors.ts          # HSL tokens (primary, semantic, glass)
│   ├── spacing.ts         # Space scale (4px base)
│   ├── typography.ts      # Font families, sizes, line heights
│   ├── radius.ts          # Border radius scale
│   ├── shadows.ts         # Elevation + glass shadows
│   ├── motion.ts          # Transition durations, easings
│   └── index.ts
├── globals.css            # CSS custom properties + base styles
├── glassmorphism.css      # Glass utilities (backdrop-filter, borders)
└── theme-provider.tsx     # React context for theme switching
```

## Token Specs (from branding)
| Category | Values |
|----------|--------|
| **Primary HSL** | 220 85% 55% (GoalChain blue) |
| **Glass BG** | `hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.08)` / `hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.6)` |
| **Glass Border** | `hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.12)` |
| **Motion** | `fast: 150ms`, `base: 250ms`, `slow: 400ms` |
| **Easing** | `ease-out-cubic`, `ease-in-out-quart` |

## Files to Create
- All token files + globals.css + glassmorphism.css
- `ThemeProvider` component
- Tailwind config extension (`tailwind.config.ts`)

## Verification
```bash
cd goalchain_webapp
npm run typecheck
npm run build
# Storybook: verify tokens render correctly
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- Tokens exported as TS constants + CSS custom properties
- Glassmorphism utilities work (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg)
- Motion tokens used in Framer Motion variants
- ThemeProvider supports light/dark (future)
- Zero hardcoded colors in components after migration
